case_title: PAOLETTI, MARCELLO VS UNITED AIR LINES (ATTN M. FINN)

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY PAOLETTI, MARCELLO AS TO DEFENDANT UNITED AIR LINES (ATTN M. FINN) ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUN-23-2000 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF PAOLETTI, MARCELLO IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT UNITED AIR LINES (ATTN M. FINN) PROOF OF SERVICE WAIVED. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
